answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the marble of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The canyon is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the tundra. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, reset on any identity-link attempt, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain.
